item.title: Lady dumping a large black rubbish bag, 19th September
item.description:
I asked a lady who dumped a large black rubbish bag next to the wall along the Oakland Road graveyard what she was doing. She said it was clothing and there was nowhere to put it. I pointed at the bins, clearly visible, near the bowling alley and told her there are bins right there and it was not acceptable to leave a bag on the pavement. She picked up the bag and was slowly putting it back in her car as we left. So she may have removed the bag (I haven't walked back to check). This was Sat 19 Sept at 10:25am and I have noted her car registration. If the camera near the cenotaph works, and covers this area, it may be recorded.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Oaklands Road, Bexley, Greater London
